Its weapons are now trained on your location, Gray One.''"<br />"''Command of Gray Squadron is now with Gray Ten.|"[[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold One]]" [[Kyle Katarn]] and "Gray One" Jaina Solo|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
'''Gray Leader''', or '''Gray One''', was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of Gray Squadron or Gray Flight. Both [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] used these designations, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] used the call sign of Gray Leader.

==History==
[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] used this [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] when she commanded her own secret [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]],<ref name="SW3" /> known as [[Stealth Squadron|Gray Flight]],<ref name="SW4" /> approximately [[0 ABY/Legends|two months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref>

During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] flew as Gray Leader,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|361|"Gray Leader"}}</ref> commanding the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] of [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gray Squadron]].<ref name="CCGCS" /> Salm's [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] during the battle was [[Kin Kian (Human)|Kin Kian]].<ref name="CCGKK">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Kin Kian}}</ref>

[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] used the same call sign during the early training period of his new [[Commando/Legends|commando]]/[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] squadron; which was later named as [[Wraith Squadron]]. When the Wraiths managed to capture the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] aligned ship [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], they flew its complement [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] in their covert operations under the designation [[Gray Flight (New Republic)|Gray Flight]]. As "Gray One", Antilles flew regular TIE Fighter missions which included the [[Mission to Storinal]] and the [[Battle of Talasea]]. He was replaced by [[Atril Tabanne]] from ''Night Caller's'' bridge crew before the [[Battle of Ession]].<ref name="XWWS" />

During the [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], [[Sword of the Jedi]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] led the [[New Jedi Order]]'s [[StealthX wing]] as [[Gray Squadron (New Jedi Order)|Gray Squadron's]] "Gray One," though she subsequently turned over her [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] to "[[Gray Ten]]" [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'', Gray Leader was killed during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> This was contradicted by the [[Death Star II Limited]] expansion of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]], which established Gray Leader to be Colonel Horton Salm,<ref name="CCGCS" /> a character introduced after the Battle of Endor.<ref name="XWRS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
